primary_outcomes: within-drug destination fitted-order discordance under supported and ambiguous source orders, with matched-coverage controls
leakage_controls: Destination design ranges are allowed covariates
Drug and cell identities disjoint across diagonal blocks
No tuning or test outcome reuse
Destination support strata are retrospective evaluation only
confirmatory_holdout: Untouched test-drug x test-cell block, once-only exploratory holdout; not a new independent screen or raw-data-blind confirmation
question: How much of fitted-IC50 cross-screen ranking disagreement is actually identifiable within both screens' experimental concentration support, and do continuous translation models improve the identifiable order rather than merely fitting extrapolated points?
primary_direction: GDSC1 source to GDSC2 destination, release8.5 27Oct23 fitted files
estimand: Retrospective overlapping drug-cell pairs with observed GDSC1 fitted phenotype. Operational rank-support diagnostics and drug-macro destination fitted-phenotype translation, not unmeasured biological IC50 ground truth, clinical efficacy or de novo sensitivity prediction.
allowed_information: Source fitted LN_IC50, AUC, RMSE and source/destination experimental MIN_CONC/MAX_CONC are observed. Destination concentration design is allowed; destination fitted LN_IC50/AUC/RMSE are forbidden until the relevant split is evaluated.
operational_interval: For a fitted point z and log-dose support [a,b], assign (-infinity,a] if z<a; [z,z] if a<=z<=b; [b,infinity) if z>b. This is a deliberately coarsened support representation conditional on the released monotone fitted model. It is NOT a statistical confidence interval, observed censoring event, or a guaranteed bound for true IC50.
primary_ranking: Within each held-out drug, enumerate all available cell pairs. A source order is support-determined only if its operational intervals are disjoint. Report supported fraction and destination-fitted point-order disagreement for supported versus ambiguous source orders. Additionally restrict destination comparisons to destination support-determined pairs. Average rates across drugs, not globally across all pairs.
order_bounds: For comparisons with fixed destination-fitted order, source support-determined concordant C, discordant D and ambiguous A produce conservative pairwise outer concordance bounds [C/N,(C+A)/N]. Not claimed sharp over globally coherent rankings or confidence intervals.
secondary_ml: Predict destination fitted LN_IC50 using identity, train-only global affine source translation, Ridge(alpha=1) on standardized features, and fixed HistGradientBoostingRegressor(max_iter=80,max_leaf_nodes=15,max_depth=4,min_samples_leaf=50,learning_rate=.05,l2_regularization=1,random_state=20261021). Features source LN_IC50,AUC,RMSE,log source/destination min/max,source support margins. No drug/cell ID features or target-derived summaries. Compare MAE and within-drug ordering separately on destination-supported versus unsupported points. Model complexity is secondary, not an independent replication-risk paper.
split: SHA256(seed,axis,canonical ID) partitions drug and cell identities independently 60/20/20; training destination labels only train-drug x train-cell; validation and test diagonal blocks only. Validation descriptive, no model/hyperparameter tuning. Entire untouched test drug identities reserved from any destination-based analysis.
drug_identity: Official compound annotations map DrugID to PubChem/compound identity; exact names only if uniquely consistent and corroborated. Multiple DrugIDs per compound excluded unless a deterministic source-design-only canonical representative is established before outcomes; never Cartesian merge by name.
cell_identity: Exact SANGER_MODEL_ID intersection; exclude ambiguous or missing IDs, retain COSMIC/name provenance.
primary_support: Use each screen's own min/max support; common-intersection support is a prespecified sensitivity analysis when nonempty.
uncertainty: 1000 drug-cluster bootstrap draws for descriptive macro rates and paired model contrasts; conditional on fixed test cell panel and released fits. Report unique drugs/cells; no pairwise iid p values. Cell bootstrap sensitivity only if adequate support.
stop_conditions: File-specific permitted academic reuse cannot be established
Fewer than 20 matched canonical drugs or 100 matched cells
Fewer than 10 held-out drugs with >=20 cells: feasibility-only; do not claim robust generalization
No primary rank comparison with nonzero determined and ambiguous counts: report non-evaluable boundary
Direct same-estimand prior publication discovered: replan or replication report
No material new finding beyond established max-dose bias: no paper-ready claim
novelty_boundary: 2025 specification-game paper already establishes max-concentration dummy baseline and biased global metrics; 2026 Communications Chemistry already filters out-of-range IC50. Proposed distinction is source/destination operational partial-order identifiability in paired screens, not a new discovery that extrapolated IC50 exists.
identity_review_addendum_before_join: The holdout is an official-drug-name group holdout, not structure-verified unseen-compound evaluation. As conservative alias control, exclude any distinct official names whose names or exact comma-delimited official synonyms overlap after case-folding/whitespace stripping. Do not chemically merge those names. Preserve exclusions and state remaining alias uncertainty.
canonicalization_addendum_before_join: Official release8.5 screened_compounds CSV contains DrugID, exact DRUG_NAME, SCREENING_SITE, TARGET and TARGET_PATHWAY, but no PubChem ID. Primary canonical compound key is exact official DRUG_NAME, corroborated by matching TARGET and TARGET_PATHWAY across entries; no free-text synonym merging. Exclude names with conflicting annotation. For multiple DrugIDs in a screen choose lowest numeric DrugID using identifiers only. Exclude duplicate rows for the resulting (canonical compound,SANGER_MODEL_ID), rather than average outcomes. Preserve chosen DrugIDs and screening sites; chemical identity not independently structure-verified is a limitation.
amendment_before_outcomes: Independent static review added matched-coverage rank controls and dose-only baseline before cross-screen numeric outcomes were accessed. Only workbook headers/first row per file had been read separately for schema verification; no joined outcomes inspected.
rank_controls: For each drug, compare source support-determined comparisons with the same number of comparisons selected by largest absolute source fitted-point margin and by deterministic SHA256 pair order. These are matched-coverage retrospective diagnostics, not evidence of a novel abstention algorithm. Destination ties are excluded from discordance denominators and reported. Drugs with no determinate or no ambiguous pairs are separately counted; zero-denominator metrics are null, never zero.
dose_only_baseline: Ridge(alpha=1) on standardized log source/destination min/max dose features, fitted on training diagonal only; source phenotype omitted. Report alongside identity, affine, full Ridge and HGB.
destination_support_boundary: Destination-support-defined strata are retrospective evaluation only, unavailable as source-only deployment gates.
trial_count_definition: Four fitted predictors: affine, full Ridge, full HGB, dose-only Ridge; identity and rank selectors are fixed nonfitted baselines. No tuning.
